evidence: Clicking New Resume created "Untitled Resume" with empty Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills tabs, immediately editable, and a live preview panel.

issue: Invalid experience date ranges are accepted without rejection or feedback
actual: Setting End Date (2019-01) earlier than Start Date (2020-01) was accepted and rendered in preview as "Jan 2020 - Jan 2019" with no error message. Setting Start Date to a future month (2030-01, current date 2026-08) was also accepted with no validation feedback (rendered "Jan 2030 - Jan 2019"). No error/invalid styling or alert elements appeared in the DOM.

evidence: Start/End Date inputs use HTML type="month" (consistent month/year format), preview renders as "Jan 2020 - Jun 2022". Checking "I currently work here" cleared and disabled the End Date field, and preview showed "Present" instead of an end date.

Entered contact details and summary (reflected in preview); added two Experience entries, edited fields, and reordered them via ↑/↓ (order changed in preview); added an Education entry with institution/degree/field/dates/GPA (shown in preview); added a Skill, changed its level via dropdown (Intermediate→Expert, reflected in preview), then removed it (preview updated) and re-added a new skill successfully.

Switched between Modern, Classic, and Minimal templates via Template tab; each selection updated the active state (img marker) and changed the preview layout/styling while retaining all entered content (contact, summary, experience, education, skills).
Every field edit (contact, summary, experience, education, skills) and template change was immediately reflected in the Live Preview panel without any manual save or refresh action.

Sections tab allows reordering sections (moved Education above Employment History via up arrow, preview order updated), toggling section visibility (hid Education via switch, section disappeared from preview, re-enabled it and it reappeared), and renaming headings (renamed "Work Experience" to "Employment History", preview heading updated immediately).
Section order and visibility changes reflected in the live preview immediately upon action (reorder and hide/show), no save/refresh required.
Renamed "Work Experience" heading to "Employment History" in Sections tab; the customized heading text appeared correctly in the preview for all three styles (Modern, Classic, Minimal).

Preview renders every visible section with content (Contact, Summary, Education, Employment History with 2 entries, Skills). When resume content grew tall enough to exceed the visible viewport (verified: document.body.scrollHeight 1574px > window.innerHeight 720px), no CSS clipping/overflow-hidden truncation was found on the resume content containers (scrollHeight==clientHeight, i.e. containers auto-grow to fit content); scrolling the page revealed sections that were initially off-screen, confirming the complete resume remains reachable/readable via scrolling.

Clicked "Hide Preview" - preview panel disappeared and editor tab content (Experience entries) remained intact. Clicked "Show Preview" - preview reappeared with all content (contact, summary, education, employment history, skills) and the Modern template styling intact.

issue: No validation feedback shown when rejecting empty/whitespace-only rename
actual: Entering a whitespace-only title ("   ") and submitting (Enter) correctly reverted the displayed title back to "Untitled Resume" (title was not actually changed to blank), but no toast, inline error message, or other visible feedback was shown to the user. The notifications region and all live regions remained empty of any message after the action.

evidence: Renamed resume to "QA Engineer Resume - TechCorp App" in the editor header; navigated back to dashboard and the card heading displays the identical new title.

Navigated from editor to dashboard and reopened the resume; all edits (contact, summary, experience, education, skills, section order, renamed heading, renamed title) were retained. The dashboard card also displayed "Updated Aug 24, 2026" reflecting the edit.

After switching editor tabs, returning to dashboard, and reopening the resume, Contact (Jane QA Tester, email, phone, location), Summary, Work Experience (2 entries), Education, and Skills (Selenium) content all remained present exactly as entered.

Duplicated "QA Engineer Resume - TechCorp App" via card menu → Duplicate, created "...(Copy)". Renamed the copy to "QA Engineer Resume - StartupXYZ App" and edited its Full Name field; verified original resume's title and Full Name remained unchanged.

Bidirectional independence confirmed: editing the copy's Full Name to "Jane QA Tester (Copy Edit)" did not alter the original's Full Name (remained "Jane QA Tester"); subsequently editing the original's Full Name to "Jane QA Tester (Original Edit)" did not alter the copy's Full Name (remained "Jane QA Tester (Copy Edit)").

issue: Resume data does not persist across page reload
actual: Prior to reload, dashboard had 5 resumes including two created/edited/duplicated/renamed during this session ("QA Engineer Resume - StartupXYZ App" and "QA Engineer Resume - TechCorp App"). After browser_navigate reload of http://localhost:6005/, dashboard shows only the original 3 seeded resumes (Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume) — the created/edited/duplicated/renamed resumes are gone. Inspection confirms localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty, indicating the app holds resume state only in-memory (React state) with no persistence layer, so all edits/creates/duplicates/renames/deletes are lost on reload.

evidence: During this session, successfully created a new resume, duplicated an existing resume, and renamed the duplicate to produce two distinct, independently-editable resume variations targeted at different applications ("QA Engineer Resume - TechCorp App" and "QA Engineer Resume - StartupXYZ App" with different Full Name edits, verified via bidirectional independence check in CT-17/FT-6). The dashboard concurrently lists multiple distinct resumes (different titles, templates: minimal/classic/modern, and content) confirming the app supports creating and managing several distinct resume variations within a session. (Note: persistence across reload is separately covered and failed under CS-11.)

Typed lowercase "product" into search box; only "Product Designer Resume" (title-case) remained, confirming case-insensitive title search. Cleared search box; all 3 resumes reappeared, confirming clearing search restores full list. Sort combobox offers Newest First / Oldest First / Title A-Z / Title Z-A. Default "Newest First" ordered cards Feb 25 > Feb 10 > Jan 20. Switching to "Oldest First" correctly reversed order to Jan 20 < Feb 10 < Feb 25.

issue: No date-based filtering control exists on dashboard
actual: Inspected all interactive controls on the dashboard (DOM query of input/button/select elements): only a text search box ("Search resumes...") and a sort-order combobox (Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A) are present, plus per-card kebab menus. There is no date picker, date-range input, or any control allowing users to narrow saved resumes by exact creation date or a date range. Sorting by date only reorders results; it does not filter/narrow them. Therefore the feature to filter by creation date or date range is not implemented.
